narrative.overview: PressBig is the day's edit drawn as a poster hoarding that someone has torn back by hand. Today's picks sit on the top layer of chalk paper; the tear exposes the four section layers pasted up beneath, each in its own ink. Four inks (black, indigo, red, wheat) on chalk over paste-gray backing; Anton for names, Gloock for story headlines, mono for labels and body. Depth is paper lift, not UI shadow.
keyCharacteristics: Torn edges on every container, button and band via SVG turbulence displacement, never border-radius.
Four inks on chalk; each section owns one ink.
Halftone, grayscale-and-tint pictures that resolve to color on hover or focus.
Small deliberate rotations so the wall reads as hand-pasted.
One authored motion moment: strips pulled out from behind the tear on load.

rules.name: The Four Inks Rule
rules.body: Every filled surface is chalk, gray, or one of black, indigo, red, wheat. No gradients, no off-palette brand colors (share-icon brand colors are flattened to one-ink silhouettes).

rules.name: The Section Ink Rule
rules.body: Entertainment is black, Fashion & Style is indigo, Gadgets is red, Celebrity & Culture is wheat, everywhere that section appears (hero strips, bands, picture tint).

rules.name: The Chalk Text Rule
rules.body: Text on black, indigo and red paper is chalk; text on wheat and chalk is black.

rules.name: The Anton Is Loud Rule
rules.body: Display is Anton, uppercase, line-height 0.88, letter-spacing 0, and only for names of things (sections, page titles, the headline). Never for sentences of running copy.

rules.name: The Mono Is Small Rule
rules.body: Mono carries labels and body; it is always uppercase and tracked when 0.875rem or smaller and bold.

rules.name: The Paper Lift Rule
rules.body: The only shadow is a drop-shadow filter on a torn sheet. Never put box-shadow on a torn element, because it would draw a straight rectangle under a ragged edge.

dos: Do build every container, button and band as a .pb-paper sheet with --paper set to one of the six inks; put the filters on the pseudo-elements only.
Do keep radius at zero and let the torn edge be the shape.
Do tie each section to its ink (black, indigo, red, wheat) and tint its pictures with it.
Do use Anton uppercase for names, Gloock for story headlines, mono for labels and body, Source Serif 4 for article prose.
Do use cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1) for all transitions, 250 to 500ms, and honor prefers-reduced-motion.
Do use red ink text (#8f3636) for small red text on chalk.
Do keep a visible focus ring: 3px black outline, 3px offset, 3px chalk halo.
donts: Don't use gradients, rounded corners, glassmorphism or box-shadow on torn elements.
Don't add colors beyond the four inks, chalk and gray (the two derived text tones excepted); flatten third-party brand colors to one ink.
Don't apply the SVG filter to the element itself; it would distort its text.
Don't build the hero plus three-column equal-card grid; vary lead size, rotation and stagger.
Don't animate layout or content on scroll; the pull-out on load is the only authored motion, and content stays visible by default.
